"Hello! Where's the Lake Town?" Bray asked an 81-year-old
tending some cows. She gave him a puzzled look. "Gee, nobody 
here speaks English," he thought. 

And although Bray had studied the local language at school for
nine years, he had pretty much forgotten everything.

So he kept pedaling along, trying to figure out how to get to the
town, and his accommodation. It was getting dark.

Suddenly, a teenager came into view; he was gathering raspberries, 
cranberries, gooseberries. To Bray's relief — and astonishment — 
the teen was able to give him directions. In perfect English.

“How did you master English?” Bray asked him. 
“Oh, from watching cartoons on TV when I was young,” he answered.

exp_info.description: Place of employment went out of business at the beginning of 2020. I started studying Spanish again with the goal of improving from conversational to fluency. In 2021 I took a course to earn a TEFL certificate. After I completed my practicum I continued to volunteer to give back and to continue to hone my teaching skills while I explore employment opportunities.

Returned to the Hospitality Industry to work in several popular restaurants (San Fermo, Maximilien, & Pintxo) after a several year hiatus to focus on art and writing. Strong communication skills were further sharpened and refined in this environment; skills and characteristics that have translated over well to English tutoring/teaching.

Continued to work on art, acting, and writing. Also ran an underground art gallery out of my art studio while working part-time in the hospitality/service industry. Multitasking and being able to mentally switch between a variety of environments daily translates into being able to comfortably accommodate a wide range of language student personalities and learning styles.

Worked at the Sitting Room for several years while studying acting, French, and eventually Spanish. Did several plays including "Take Me Out" and "Creation of the World and Other Business." Appeared in several short and feature length films as well as commercial work.
Lived in Sydney, Australia for a year. Completed an internship with "Basketball Australia" through the University of New South Wales.

As an intern with the "Mavin Foundation" contributed to a nationally published "Multiracial Child Resource Book" and the planning of the "National Conference on the Mixed Race Experience" in Seattle, which drew over 500 attendees.

Worked closely with nurses and surgery assistants to make sure they had the materials they needed to support and carry out their procedures. Attention to detail and good commununications skills were extremely important. These qualitites translate well to the teaching environment.

pro_course_detail.title: Sound Like a Native Speaker! (Intense Training on Accent, Intonation, Pronunciation & Speaking Patterns)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, we will go through a warm-up of conversation in order for me to analyze your English speaking. We will work specifically on you sounding as close to a native speaker (of standard American English) as possible. I will correct you on accent and intonation. We will also do pronunciation practice; however, unlike in general conversation practice, I will show you how to tweak your pronunciation specifically to sound more American. If you have specific goals that you want to achieve in your accent, I would also be happy to hear about them!

This is recommended for students of levels B1 and up.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn and Perfect Your English Grammar and Style! (Grammar Lessons, Academic Writing & Proofreading, Practice, and Use)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, we will work hard on English grammar and perfecting the small nuances between things like tenses, plurals, etc. We will focus specifically on how you use grammar in conversation, and upon request I can present and teach entire subjects to you in the lesson, such as a new tense (or a review of it), the difference between "a" and "an", and topics of all levels in between!

In addition, this lesson is a good choice for those who want to focus on proofreading, correcting, and strengthening academic writing skills where we will go through something you have written and focus on areas of improvement.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking Mastery: Boost Your English Conversations! 🚀

pro_course_detail.title: Interview in English Mastery: Crush that interview! 💪
